1.consolidated_definition: Trabajar una finca un agricultor rural repartiendo con el dueño los beneficios a base de la tercera parte para éste.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To work a farm as a rural farmer, dividing the profits with the owner on a three-part basis in his favor.
